extracted.intended_audience: researchers, patent historians, librarians, patent attorneys, and others consulting historical USPTO patent indexes
extracted.subtask_description: Alphabetical index (continued) from the United States Patent Office Annual Report, 1877, listing each invention title and associated bibliographic metadata (patentee, patent number, issue date, monthly volume, Official Gazette reference). Useful for locating and citing 1877 patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention or discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: Column header listing the invention or discovery (title/short description).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples on this page include entries like 'Pump, Lift', 'Pump reel, Sand', 'Quartz-mill', 'Quilting-frame', 'Railway-rail', etc. Titles are often terse, sometimes hyphenated or comma-separated to indicate subtype (e.g., 'Pump, Oil-well').

rubrics_metrics.name: Name of patentee
rubrics_metrics.description: Column header giving the name(s) of the patentee(s) associated with the invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'J.C. Wright', 'G.F. Blake', 'J. B. Moutier', 'W. H. Morris', 'A. E. Furness', and multi‑name entries like 'C. C. Mason and J. F. Bracket'.

rubrics_metrics.name: No.
rubrics_metrics.description: Column header providing the patent number (official U.S. patent number).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples from the index: '189,017', '197,376', '193,852', '191,509', etc. Numbers are printed with commas as thousands separators in this historical document (e.g., '197, 376').

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.description: Column header giving the issue date of the patent (month, day, year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Monthly volume
rubrics_metrics.description: Column header indicating the monthly volume number in which the patent notice appears (bibliographic/serial reference).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric volume identifiers appear (e.g., '904', '765', '142', '1364') aligned with each entry; used for locating the patent announcement in the periodical record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official Gazette
rubrics_metrics.description: Column header giving the Official Gazette pagination or reference where the patent is reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show page or reference numbers (e.g., '489', '494', '82', '1005') corresponding to the Official Gazette listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: Arrangement rule: the list is organized alphabetically by invention title (section header: 'Alphabetical list of inventions—Continued').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This section continues the alphabetical index (here covering entries starting with 'P' through 'R' and 'Q' to 'R' entries), so users should search alphabetically by invention title. Subentries and variants (e.g., 'Pump, Steam', 'Pump, Steam and vacuum') are grouped under the main alphabetical heading.
